name: zerotrace
description: Read-only, evidence-first on-chain market-structure forensic analysis for EVM, Bitcoin, and Solana.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @zerotrace/api && npm run build -w @zerotrace/web && npm run build -w @zerotrace/ingest-worker && npm run build -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker && npm run build -w @zerotrace/simulation-worker && npm run build -w @zerotrace/llm-worker
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others --names packages,api,web "tsc -b tsconfig.packages.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w @zerotrace/api" "npm run dev -w @zerotrace/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @zerotrace/api
scripts.ingest: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @zerotrace/ingest-worker && npm run start -w @zerotrace/ingest-worker --
scripts.flap:origin: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker && npm run start -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker --
scripts.flap:history: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker && npm run start:history -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker --
scripts.flap:lifetime: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker && npm run start:lifetime -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker --
scripts.flap:lifetime:heads: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker && npm run start:lifetime:heads -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker --
scripts.claims:burn:promote: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker && npm run start:burn:promote -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker --
scripts.claims:supply:scan: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker && npm run start:supply:scan -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker --
scripts.actions:capture: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker && npm run start:actions:capture -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker --
scripts.actions:schedule: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker && npm run start:actions:schedule -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker --
scripts.claims:actions:capture: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker && npm run start:claims:actions:capture -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker --
scripts.claims:actions:schedule: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker && npm run start:claims:actions:schedule -w @zerotrace/semantic-worker --
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:evals && npm run test:mcp
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --coverage packages services apps/api/test tests/integration --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:replay:offline: cargo test -p zerotrace-replay --offline || cargo test -p zerotrace-replay
scripts.test:property: vitest run packages/provider-scheduler packages/source-registry packages/provider-plane packages/local-index packages/storage-plane packages/token-market-capture packages/capital-intelligence packages/campaign-intelligence
scripts.verify:terminal: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && npm run architecture:check && npm run test:property && npm run forensic:golden
scripts.forensic:golden: vitest run packages/supply-reality-engine packages/identity-intelligence packages/campaign-intelligence packages/capital-intelligence packages/market-reality-engine evals/market-structure
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run license:check && npm run audit && npm run architecture:check && npm run ui:chinese:check && npm run schema:drift:check
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e && npm run sbom && npm run forensic:golden && npm run market-exit:golden
